# Password Hygiene Quick Guide

*A one-page guide with a short practice set*

## Part 0 · Start Here

### 0.1 What this guide does

Quick reference for safer passwords [R1].

## Practice Lab · 3 Scenario Questions

**Q1.** Which password is strongest for a bank account? [M1-CAC] A. Summer2026 · B. correct horse battery staple 8421 · C. password1 · D. The user's pet name

**Q2.** (numeric) A password uses 12 characters from a 62 symbol set. How many digits long is the number of combinations, to the nearest integer? [M1-CAP]

**Q3.** (rubric) Explain why a password manager reduces credential stuffing risk. [M1-CUC]

## Answer Key

| Q | Ans | Domain | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | B | D1 | Length and randomness beat a predictable pattern; the tempting A adds only a year |
| 2 | 22 ± 0 | D1 | 62 to the power 12 is about 3.2 times ten to the 21, which has 22 digits |
| 3 | Rubric | D1 | Criteria: (C1) unique password per site; (C2) leaked pairs fail elsewhere; (C3) manager makes unique passwords practical |

Scoring: 2 of 3 is a good first run.
